faqs: How do I choose between the panel models listed?
Compare power (Wp), efficiency, cell technology, dimensions and warranty on each product page, or add up to four models to the comparison table. Every listing links to the manufacturer datasheet.

Listed prices are indicative. We re-check them when you send an enquiry and confirm the final price, GST, availability and delivery with you on WhatsApp.
Can I order panels in project quantities?
Yes. Add the models and quantities you need to the enquiry basket and send it to us on WhatsApp in one message.
Do you deliver outside Chennai?
Tell us your delivery location in the enquiry and we will confirm the delivery options for your order.

Use the System Size and Kit Builder tools on this site. They check your panel string voltage and current against the inverter limits listed in the datasheet.
